verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only says that LibreOffice has API docs and a Developers Guide for SDK extension work. It shows no interactive API explorer and no runnable examples, so a static reference does not deliver the interactive, runnable experience this story asks for. A community user also reported being unable to find docs for a JavaScript API for Calc.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
